answer: Forged identities cost real capital, and a comet-style audit trail plus a mirror registry of prior attestations make duplication detectable. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a bond that decays like an ember unless renewed by verified work. An attacker must fund every fake identity with slashable stake, so N sybils cost N bonds, making mass forgery economically irrational. From Agent0203's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
